# MeTTaScript

> MeTTa (OpenCog Hyperon) for TypeScript: an interpreter in pure TypeScript plus the packages around it —
> atom construction, a typed eDSL, files and a CLI, property testing, visual reduction, and Python,
> Prolog and Distributed AtomSpace interop. No native addons and no required WASM; runs in browsers,
> Node, Deno, Bun and edge runtimes.

Each package carries an `LLMS.md`: a one-page, high-density reference written for a language model that
needs to USE it — API surface, working code, and the traps that produce wrong programs. Read the one for
the package you need; they cross-link and do not repeat each other.

Start with `core` for the evaluation model (rewrite vs match, why every result is an array), then the
package that matches your job. `core` deliberately exports no atom constructors: if you are building
atoms from TypeScript values you want `hyperon` or `edsl`.

## Engine

- [core](packages/core/LLMS.md): the interpreter. Source text in, result atoms out; parser, static
  analysis, spaces, the evaluation model every other package inherits.
- [hyperon](packages/hyperon/LLMS.md): class API modeled on Python `hyperon`. Build atoms (`E S V G`),
  hold them in spaces, run a stateful `MeTTa`, register grounded operations. Use this to cross JS↔MeTTa.
- [edsl](packages/edsl/LLMS.md): typed TypeScript eDSL. Proxy-minted names and variables, combinators, a
  tagged template, auto-grounding, a typed host bridge in both directions.

## Runtimes

- [node](packages/node/LLMS.md): the `metta` CLI, filesystem `import!`, worker-thread parallel matcher.
  Re-exports all of `core`.
- [browser](packages/browser/LLMS.md): browser entry with an in-memory virtual file system so `import!`
  works without disk; async runner for `par`/`race`/`hyperpose`.

## Libraries and tooling

- [libraries](packages/libraries/LLMS.md): pure MeTTa standard libraries (`vector`, `spaces`, `nars`,
  `pln`, …), registered by a side-effecting import and loaded with `(import! &self <name>)`.
- [fuzz](packages/fuzz/LLMS.md): property testing written in MeTTa — generators as data, stable
  shrinking, exhaustive enumeration, model-vs-real state machines, bounded reachability.
- [debug](packages/debug/LLMS.md): host-free debugger engine; you pass in the runner, it explains the
  call.
- [grapher](packages/grapher/LLMS.md): visual editor and reduction renderer, node-graph or nested-block
  views, GIF export.

## Interop

- [py](packages/py/LLMS.md): Python via a caller-supplied bridge — `py-call`, `py-eval`, the `py-atom`
  family. Async; pythonia on Node, Pyodide in browsers.
- [prolog](packages/prolog/LLMS.md): Prolog via SWI (`swipl` executable on Node, `swipl-wasm` in
  browsers) — `Predicate`, `prolog-call`, `assertzPredicate`.
- [das-client](packages/das-client/LLMS.md): SingularityNET Distributed AtomSpace over gRPC, Node-only;
  presents a DAS as a `Space`.
- [das-gateway](packages/das-gateway/LLMS.md): transport-agnostic DAS bridge over Connect/HTTP, reachable
  from a browser.

## Optional
